title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Connecticut College, from expansive arboretum trails to student-run performance venues and art galleries.

cards.title: Stroll the Native Plant Collection
cards.subtitle: Connecticut College Arboretum
cards.notes: Walk through 25 acres of woody plants and wildflowers. Use the Williams Street entrance to access easy walking paths and the four-acre pond for a quiet outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A 25-acre collection of native trees and shrubs featuring easy walking trails and a central pond.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is free and open to the public sunrise to sunset, 365 days a year.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset. Free street parking is available at the Williams Street entrance.

cards.title: Relax on Tempel Green
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Commons
cards.notes: Gather for a picnic or group study session on this expansive lawn. It offers sweeping views of the Long Island Sound and features an outdoor classroom made of granite.
cards.short_summary: The central campus green used for social gatherings, picnics, and outdoor studying with water views.
cards.evidence_claim: Tempel Green, which offers sweeping views of Long Island Sound, is a favorite place to study and relax.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; most active during daylight hours in warmer months.

cards.title: Explore the Lyman Allyn
cards.subtitle: South Campus Art Museum
cards.notes: Browse permanent collections and rotating exhibitions. Students and staff at Connecticut College receive free general admission to the galleries and outdoor sculpture trail.
cards.short_summary: An art museum located at the south end of campus featuring over 17,000 objects and a sculpture trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Students and staff at Connecticut College receive free general admission.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission - Lyman Allyn Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 10am-5pm and Sunday 1pm-5pm. Closed Mondays.

cards.title: Study in Shain Library
cards.subtitle: Campus Research Hub
cards.notes: Utilize collaborative study areas and whiteboards for group work. The first floor is a social, non-quiet space ideal for meeting classmates near the Blue Camel Cafe.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering diverse study environments from social lounges to quiet research floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Shain Library features classrooms and collaborative study areas... the first floor is traditionally not a quiet space.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; check website for specific late-night hours for students.

cards.title: Visit the Cummings Gallery
cards.subtitle: Cummings Arts Center
cards.notes: View faculty and student-curated exhibitions in this on-campus gallery. It is free and open to the public, showcasing diverse media from sculpture to digital art.
cards.short_summary: A professional gallery space within the Cummings Arts Center hosting rotating contemporary art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joanne Toor Cummings Gallery, located in Cummings Arts Center, is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are typically Monday-Friday 9am-5pm and Saturday-Sunday 1pm-4pm.

cards.title: Attend a Chapel Performance
cards.subtitle: Historic Performance Venue
cards.notes: Listen to a cappella concerts or student recitals in this non-denominational space. The chapel is known for its superb acoustics and quintessential campus silhouette.
cards.short_summary: A historic 400-seat chapel used for religious services, musical performances, and guest lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: Harkness Chapel hosts a variety of musical performances each year, including a cappella concerts and student recitals.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events and services; check the campus calendar for public performance dates.

cards.title: Hike Mamacoke Island
cards.subtitle: Arboretum Natural Area
cards.notes: Trek through this 40-acre rocky island attached by a tidal salt marsh. It is a designated Important Bird Area, perfect for winter duck watching and nature photography.
cards.short_summary: A rugged natural area within the Arboretum offering hiking trails and bird-watching opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Mamacoke Island... is a designated natural area within the Connecticut College Arboretum... open to the public free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Arboretum; check tide charts as the marsh crossing is best at low tide.

cards.title: Hang Out in Cro Pit
cards.subtitle: Crozier-Williams Student Center
cards.notes: Meet friends in the heart of campus activity. This central lounge area in 'Cro' is the hub for student clubs, mail services, and casual social interaction.
cards.short_summary: The primary social lounge and activity hub located within the Crozier-Williams College Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the center of campus, the College Center at Crozier-Williams... is home to Cro Pit... the heart of campus activity.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; primary student hub with late-night access for residents.

cards.title: Visit Caroline Black Garden
cards.subtitle: Landscaped Arboretum Collection
cards.notes: Explore a diverse collection of ornamental trees and shrubs across from the main campus. This garden features a small stream and mature conifers for a peaceful retreat.
cards.short_summary: A four-acre landscaped garden showcasing diverse plant species for landscaping and aesthetic enjoyment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Caroline Black Garden... is open to the public every day of the year from sunrise to sunset. General admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Located off Route 32; parking is available behind Vinal Cottage.

cards.title: Rock Out at the Barn
cards.subtitle: Student Music Space
cards.notes: Watch student bands practice or perform in this converted squash court. It features a full sound system and a second-level balcony for spectators.
cards.short_summary: A student-run music practice and performance venue managed by Musicians Organized for Bands Rights on Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: MOBROC Barn... provides bands with access to this practice and performance space... a converted squash court.
cards.access_notes: Primarily a student-use space; performances are often open to the campus community.
